newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights - USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights - USDA.

text.p: USDA corn export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 860,200 MT--a marketing-year high--were 12 percent above the previous week and 30 percent above the 4-week average. The major increases were for Japan (282,100 MT, includes 314,100 new sales, 15,600 destination changes, 47,600 foreign purchases/cancellations),the Philippines (150,000 MT), Malaysia (100,000 MT, includes 50,000 new sales, 50,000 destination changes), Taiwan (86,700 MT), Colombia (74,300 MT), and Mexico (52,000 MT). Reductions were reported for unknown

Exports of 1,048,900 MT--the largest since the marketing year began--were one-quarter above the week earlier and 46 percent above the 4-week average. The primary destinations were Japan (436,900 MT), South Korea (220,300 MT), Mexico (102,100 MT), Taiwan (77,700 MT), Venezuela (55,600 MT), and Malaysia (55,000 MT).
